meta.orientation: every [a, b] pair is [A, B] = the two names of the ufcstats BOUT string in order
meta.rounds: one row per scored round of a decision. Stats are ufcstats per-round counts for A and B (x_l landed, x_a attempted; sig = head+body+leg = dist+clinch+ground; ctrl in seconds; kd, sub (attempts), rev (reversals)). mins = round length actually fought. end_rnd = the fight ended in this round (technical decisions can end early). ded_A/ded_B = points deducted from A/B in the round (null if unknown). nA/nB/nE = judges giving the round to A/B/even before deductions (published when raw_known=false); n_wide = judges with a margin >= 2 (10-8 or wider).
meta.scores: one row per judge per round: ri = row index into rounds.rows, jid = MMA Decisions judge id (negative = no id, matched by name), pos = card position on MMA Decisions, A/B = published score, A_raw/B_raw = before deductions (null when unknown).
meta.load: pd.DataFrame(d['rounds']['rows'], columns=d['rounds']['cols']); same for scores; merge scores.ri -> rounds index
